P1Hero landmarks pit block and control tower never render

The brief and the landmark registry still call them required.Move both to an anchor outside the pit complex footprint (e.g. behind the garages, larger gap), or drop them and the registry ids; do not leave dead required groups.

Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut from the matrix: dawn only for dry (6 frames); eye/trackside only for dry day plus 2 night eye frames; no wet/fog/overcast at dusk, night or dawn; no frames at s 0.92–0.99 other than s=0.83 and s=0 orbits, so the portico, talud gate, Confitería and lake were not framed directly.
  • Lap positions were the fixed six fracs, not the landmark fracs; Confitería (0.745), lake (≈0.80) and portico (0.928) need targeted views.
  • The first (pre-merge) dry frames were taken before the lighting-branch merge; dry is unaffected by it but I did not re-shoot them.
  • Built banking, real-world radii and the corner-to-name mapping were not measured. Parity, GPU census and a real-GPU look were not run (no GPU here).
  • Defect “sky ignores overcast” may already be a known shared issue; I did not search the ledger.
